request.description: Debit, credit and balance of every ledger account (lender receivables, commission revenue, GST output, partner payables, commission expense, TDS payable, bank). The ledger is double-entry and append-only; journals that do not balance are refused by the database. Added for finance close. Staff context: finance acts; compliance reads. Money is in paise.
